question:
(a) For a nucleus $*{Z}^{A}X$, write the expression for mass defect in terms of proton mass, neutron mass and nuclear mass.
(b) Hence obtain the expression for binding energy and explain its physical significance.

options.A:
(a) $\Delta m=M-[Zm_p+(A-Z)m_n]$.
(b) $E_b=M c^2$; it is energy produced by electrons.
options.B:
(a) $\Delta m=Zm_p+(A-Z)m_n+M$.
(b) $E_b=\Delta m/c^2$; it measures nuclear radius.
options.C:
(a) $\Delta m=[Zm_p+(A-Z)m_n]-M$.
(b) $E_b=\Delta mc^2$. It is the energy needed to completely separate the nucleus into free nucleons, and a larger binding energy per nucleon generally indicates greater stability.
options.D:
(a) $\Delta m=Z+(A-Z)-M$.
(b) $E_b=\Delta m^2c$; it is the kinetic energy of protons.
